Fix https://github.com/VirtusLab/orca/issues/190 (Fixes #190).

On case-insensitive filesystems (macOS APFS), runner tests fail with:
  java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: orca/Flow$package$ (wrong name: orca/flow$package$)

Cause: two top-level-definition files in package `orca` compile to class names differing only in case:
- runner/src/main/scala/orca/flow.scala -> orca/flow$package$.class
- flow/src/main/scala/orca/Flow.scala -> orca/Flow$package$.class

Fix: rename one of the two files (prefer renaming runner/src/main/scala/orca/flow.scala to a name describing its contents) so that the generated `$package` class names no longer differ only in case. Update any references to the file name (docs, AGENTS.md, comments). Also check the whole repo for any other top-level-definition files in the same package whose names differ only in case, and fix those too. No behavior change; the build and tests must pass.
